title: Swimwear shopping app: home and category grid with a sticky cart bar
attribution_visible_in_image: Visible: '@uix.vikram' (credit badge; also the username shown on screen). Not confirmed as the creator.
contains_third_party_content: Product photos of swimwear and goggles (may show brands).

observed.layout: Two phones on a pale blue gradient. Home: greeting 'Welcome Back uix.vikram', avatar, cart button with a red dot; search 'What's on your list?' with a filter button; chips (All Products active and filled blue, Swimming, Goggles, Sw... cut off); a blue gradient promo 'Get 30% OFF on Swimwear! Limited time offer. Shop now!' with a yellow 'Shop Now' pill and carousel dots; 'Featured Products' cards (photo, blue price pill over the image, red heart, red '15 Stocks Left', 4.5 (201), name); bottom tabs Home (active, blue), Orders, Favorites, Profile. Category: back button, search 'Men's Fashion' with a 'Men' dropdown, a horizontally scrolling filter row (Filter, Rating, Size, Color, Brand), icon tiles (Goggles active, T-Shirts, Trunks, Swim Bag, Kick...), a two-column product grid with the same card anatomy and a sticky blue bar 'View your cart 3x $256.00'.
observed.hierarchy: Promo banner and product cards; the sticky cart bar on the second screen.
observed.typography: Rounded sans; bold names and prices, small grey metadata. Typeface unconfirmed.
observed.iconography: Icon plus label tabs; filled heart icons.
observed.materials: White cards, blue gradient banner and cart bar, price pill over photos.

implementation_notes: Horizontal-scroll chip and filter rows; sticky bottom bar.
Uniform card anatomy: image, price pill, heart, stock note, rating, name.

concept_work.essence: Uniform card anatomy and one active-state blue make a catalog easy to scan.
what_makes_it_work: Every product card has the same anatomy.
Blue consistently means active, selected, price or cart.
The sticky cart bar keeps count and total in view.
Yellow isolates the single promo action.
gaps_to_make_it_work: The second featured card shows a T-shirt named 'FORM Smart Swim Goggles 2' (duplicate name).
The search says 'Men's Fashion' in a store whose categories are swimming gear.
Every heart looks filled, so favorite state cannot be read.
Inactive 'Orders' tab label measures about 1.73-1.82:1 and the search placeholder about 2.04-2.27:1.

links: The cart dot, the '3x' count and the total connect the header to the sticky bar.
Blue active state ties chips, tiles, tabs and price pills together.

approach: Carousel, sticky bar and horizontal-scroll rows

pattern.name: Commerce home plus grid with a sticky cart bar
adaptation_examples: Grocery app: price pill becomes unit price; cart bar shows delivery slot.
failure_modes: Placeholder content that contradicts the store

lessons: Check that product names, images and category scope agree before presenting a mockup.
Make the favorite on and off states visibly different.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
measured.color_roles: White cards on a pale blue ground; one saturated blue for active, selected, price and cart; yellow used once for the promo action; red for urgency and favorites.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: A catalog shopping flow whose parts are clear.
Strong card rhythm, one saturated blue, clean gradient backdrop.
Commerce conventions are followed, but a duplicated product name and a mismatched search scope break content correctness.
Active states are shown; the favorite state is unreadable.
Cards, chips, tabs and bars share radii and the same blue.
A conventional commerce layout executed well.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 1.73:1; secondary text min 2.04:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

critical_failures.description: A primary text/label measures below 3:1 contrast (best estimate)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
